purpose: Single internal source of verified product facts. Platform-specific commerce and discovery records (OpenAI, Google, Perplexity, Schema.org) are generated FROM this file. Nothing here is published directly.
internal_item_id_note: Stable neutral internal identifier chosen for Phase 2A. No pre-existing internal item ID was found in this repository; the only prior identifier strings (JUMVI-001, JMV-TC-001) appear solely inside a noindex draft page and are unresolved - see identifiers.unresolved. This value is an INTERNAL key only and is never emitted as sku or mpn.

openai_feed_model._note: The OpenAI Stable product feed specification supports third-party marketplace offers. Verbatim: 'For a third-party seller, seller_name identifies that seller and marketplace_seller identifies the marketplace where checkout occurs.' marketplace_seller is documented as 'Conditionally required for third-party marketplace offers; requires setup'. Verified against https://developers.openai.com/commerce/specs/feed.md on 2026-09-12.
openai_feed_model.seller_name_role: the third-party seller supplying the offer
openai_feed_model.marketplace_seller_policy: The conceptual shape - brand sells as a third-party seller, checkout happens on Amazon - is supported by the Stable specification. The exact registered value must be supplied by OpenAI during feed setup and must NOT be guessed.

marketplace.marketplace_id_note: Verified Amazon US marketplace identifier. Used by the offer source; not emitted in the OpenAI feed.

feed_main_image._note: The homepage primary image is the lifestyle action shot. For a commerce feed the full-set shot on a white background is the better main image: it shows 4 paddles, 4 balls, the mesh bag and the printed retail box together.

media.format_note: The Stable specification defines image_url as 'Main product image, showing this variant. Use a direct image URL, such as a JPEG or PNG.' JPEG and PNG are given as EXAMPLES; the spec does not state that WebP is rejected. Current production images are WebP and remain valid candidates. A JPEG derivative is prepared as a defensive compatibility optimisation, not because a schema blocker has been demonstrated.
media.crawlable_source: Phase 1 removed the asset-level X-Robots-Tag and allowed Googlebot-Image / Bingbot-Image; /assets/ now serves index, follow, max-image-preview:large.

dynamic_offer_facts._note: Price and availability are live Amazon offer facts and are never stored here as static values. They are NOT equally blocking - see each entry.

price.spec_requirement: REQUIRED by the OpenAI Stable feed specification, in '<amount> <CURRENCY>' format, and must be current.
price.blocking_reason: This is THE dynamic blocker for submission. There is no current-price source or update pipeline. A price that is required and must be current cannot be satisfied by a one-off manual value that immediately goes stale.

availability.spec_requirement: REQUIRED, but 'unknown' is an explicitly accepted value. Omitted, empty or unrecognised values reject the row.
availability.blocking_reason: Not a discovery blocker. 'unknown' is a valid, honest value that makes no stock claim, so the absence of an automated stock source does not prevent a discovery feed. Automating this to a real in_stock / out_of_stock value remains highly desirable for buyer experience and is expected to help ranking.

amazon_offer_source.priority: price first - it is the only required-and-must-be-current field with no source

primary.api: Amazon Selling Partner API - Product Pricing API v0
primary.why: Official description: 'Returns pricing information for a seller's offer listings based on seller SKU or ASIN.' It is a seller-owned operational source, it accepts the ASIN we have already verified, and it needs no seller SKU to get started.
primary.documented_rate_limit: 0.5 requests per second, burst 1 (usage plans are dynamic and may be higher)

optional_enrichment.api: Amazon Selling Partner API - Listings Items v2021-08-01
optional_enrichment.precondition: requires a VERIFIED seller SKU, which is not on file
optional_enrichment.why: Richer listing-level attributes once the seller SKU is confirmed. Not required to unblock price.

optional_availability.api: Amazon Selling Partner API - FBA Inventory
optional_availability.why: Real stock automation, to replace availability 'unknown' with a verified value.

rejected.reason: DEPRECATED by Amazon and replaced by the Creators API. It is also affiliate/publisher tooling returning general marketplace offers rather than our own seller offer, which is the wrong semantic relationship for stating our own price.
Affiliate-oriented successor to PA-API 5. Not a seller-owned source for our own offer price.
Against Amazon's terms, fragile, and produces data we cannot stand behind.

output.availability: one of the allowed_values above; may remain 'unknown'

contract.on_failure: Do not emit the record. Never substitute a cached, estimated or previously seen value.

ratings_and_reviews._note: No rating or review data is asserted anywhere in this project. Amazon review data belongs to Amazon and is not republished here.

physical_attributes._note: Not asserted. No verified source in this project for product or package dimensions, weight, or materials beyond the EVA paddle construction stated in the contents list.

canonical_description: JUMVI is a 2–4 player toss-and-catch activity set for ages 3–12 with 4 hand-strap paddles, 4 sticky balls and 36 Guided Missions across 6 skill packs. The Mission Hub opens in a mobile browser from the QR Mission Card — no app download and no signup.

drift_targets._note: Fields the validator compares against the live homepage JSON-LD at https://www.jumvi.co/ to detect factual drift between this file and what is actually published.
